Product Features

  • Simple design: With its clean lines and simple design, it blends seamlessly into any modern décor and creates a relaxed and calming atmosphere in your bedroom.
  • Height-adjustable headboard: The height of the headboard is adjustable, and the adjustable height range is about 6cm difference. People of different heights can find the best comfort point by adjusting the height of the headboard. The applicable mattress thickness is about 16-22 cm.
  • Comfortable Sleeping Experience: Thickly padded 55cm high headboard to lean on while reading or watching TV.The bed slats are made of 100% high-quality pine wood, evenly distributed, and can be easily attached to the bed frame by Velcro to ensure a stable sleeping experience. Thanks to the high headboard and footboard of the bed, you don't have to worry about the mattress slipping while sleeping.
  • Durable Quality: Thanks to its sturdy construction and strong metal leg, it is easy to assemble and provides excellent support for any type of mattress. Not only does it provide a comfortable place to sleep, but it also provides a sturdy base for a restful night's sleep.
  • **To reduce the risk of damage, the 140/160/180 size bed frame is shipped in 2 packages that can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.
